bounded_question: How does node #115 build the OptionTypeInfo record for a custom shared_ptr SliceTransform option, and how do the record's two create hooks resolve that option by name?

fields.name: padding
fields.note: never written by the builder or by the copy helper; its content is indeterminate

fields.name: type
fields.note: the custom-shared-ptr kind this builder writes

builder.stack_temp: The builder first fills an identical 0xb8-byte record as a stack temporary at rsp+0x20 (offset at temp+0x00, hooks at temp+0x18, type 22 at temp+0xa8, verification at temp+0xac, flags at temp+0xb0) and then installs it into out with the record-copy helper 0x5e332c0 (site 0x6083b76). It also builds the create-hook std::function itself on the stack at rsp+0x00 (32 bytes: zero _Any_data, manager at +0x10, invoker at +0x18).
builder.cleanup: After the copy the builder destroys the stack functor (manager op 3, site 0x6083b90) and each of the temporary record's five std::function members in turn (manager op 3, sites 0x6083c19 for the create-hook member at rsp+0x28, 0x6083c00 for rsp+0x48, 0x6083be7 for rsp+0x68, 0x6083bce for rsp+0x88, 0x6083baf for rsp+0xa8). Every one of those calls is a proven no-op: the lambda captures nothing (so its manager's op 3 returns 0 without touching memory) and the other four members are zero. The record destructor 0x5d3f950 is called ONLY on the landing pad (site 0x6083c55), not on the normal path. This differs from the SystemClock sibling builder 0x5fd0180 (open PR #3715), whose normal path calls the record destructor (site 0x5fd0285) and emits no per-member op-3 calls: the SliceTransform builder inlines the destructor's member destroys.

copy_helper.role: OptionTypeInfo copy-assignment, pinned by open PR #3715 and cited here by contract: copies the 4-byte offset, then for each of the five std::function members at +0x08/+0x28/+0x48/+0x68/+0x88 zeroes the destination member, clones it through the source member's manager with op 2 when the manager is non-null, and copies the manager+invoker pair; then copies type+verification (8 bytes at +0xa8) and flags (4 bytes at +0xb0). Shared by every OptionTypeInfo installer in the binary (91 direct call sites, including this builder's site 0x6083b76 and the SystemClock builder's site 0x5fd0266).

manager.role: The std::function manager for the AsCustomSharedPtr<const SliceTransform> lambda. Op 0 (get_type_info) writes the typeinfo object 0x64d3018; op 1 (get_functor_ptr) copies the functor pointer; ops 2 (clone), 3 (destroy) and anything else return 0 without touching memory. It has no direct call site: it is reached only through the GOT slot 0x64eda68 and the copy helper's indirect manager call. Pinned here for the first time.

invoker.role: std::function _M_invoke for the AsCustomSharedPtr<const SliceTransform> lambda: Status (const ConfigOptions&, const std::string&, const std::string&, void*), returned through a hidden sret pointer in rdi. Reached only through the GOT slot 0x64edb70; it has no direct call site.

args.config_options: rdx (passed to the create host as its 2nd arg)
args.dest_slot: r9 (pointer to the destination shared_ptr slot)

id_fast_path.condition: id_string length == 2 and its first two bytes are 'id' (word 0x6469, site 0x6080a33) and name_string length == 0 (site 0x6080a3a)
id_fast_path.effect: Release the shared_ptr at *(dest_slot): zero the 16-byte slot, then call _M_release 0x5d350c0 (site 0x6080a51) on the old control block when non-null (the packed use/weak fast path and the use-count decrement live inside _M_release itself, pinned by open PR #3674). Then write an empty Status (code 0, subcode 0, state null) to out and return out.

forward_path.effect: Forward to the create-by-name host and return out.

create_host.role: Create-by-name host for the SliceTransform option: resolves the name through the registry translator and the SliceTransform registry find, creates the object through the found entry's factory, and installs it into the destination shared_ptr. Pinned here for the first time.

once_init.detail: std::call_once over the once control at 0x6508928: the TLS slots 0x64ed818 (__once_callable) and 0x64ed820 (__once_call) are loaded with the registry initializer 0x61ccfa0 and the stack argument, then pthread_once is called with __once_proxy (GLOB_DAT at 0x64ed828). On pthread_once failure the host throws a system error (site 0x61cb2e4).

translator.outputs: Writes a Status at rsp+0x60 and the translated name into the string at rsp+0xf0 (length at rsp+0xf8). The 0x28-byte stack struct at rsp+0xc0 is initialised to {0, 0, 1.0f, 0, 0} before the call; its +0x08 field is read together with the translated-name length in the empty-name test, and the epilogue frees a linked list rooted at its +0x00 field (site 0x61ca7fd).

outcomes.effect: Call the registry find 0x61c9d70 (site 0x61ca580) with (out std::function at rsp+0x110, config_options+0x40, key = the translated-name string at rsp+0xf0). If the found functor's manager (rsp+0x120) is null, build an error Status code 3 with message slices ("Could not load SliceTransform", translated name) via the Status builder 0x61cf670 (site 0x61cafbc). Otherwise invoke the found entry's factory through its invoker (indirect call *0x128(%rsp), site 0x61ca5fc) with (functor at rsp+0x110, translated-name string at rsp+0xf0, object out-slot at rsp+0xa0 pointing at rsp+0x58, detail out-string at rsp+0x90 pointing at rsp+0x130).

create_results.effect: Error Status code 4 via 0x61cf670 (site 0x61cb05c) with message slices (detail string, translated name).

create_results.effect: Error Status code 4 via 0x61cf670 (site 0x61cabc8) with message slices ("Could not load SliceTransform", translated name).

create_results.effect: Error Status code 4 via 0x61cf670 (site 0x61cae1b) with message slices ("Cannot make a shared SliceTransform from unguarded one ", translated name).

create_results.effect: Install the created object into *dest_slot: allocate a 0x18-byte control block via _Znwm (site 0x61ca696), load the packed counts 0x100000001 from the global at 0x459b20, install {object, control} into dest, set the control block's table to 0x64d7878+0x10 = 0x64d7888 (the _Sp_counted_ptr<const SliceTransform*, _S_atomic> table, typeinfo 0x64d75c0, name at 0x97e600) and its packed counts and object pointer, release the old dest control through the same counted-release dance, and write an empty Status to the intermediate at rsp+0x70.

status_normalization.input: the intermediate Status at rsp+0x60 (after the install or error path)
rules: code == 3 (NotSupported, per RocksDB's Status code table — inference) and config_options+1 != 0: reset the intermediate Status to empty; out = empty (site 0x61ca968).
code == 0: call the second translator 0x609e2d0 (site 0x61ca9c9; by contract) with (rsp+0xa0, config_options, *dest_slot object, current object), then move the Status at rsp+0xa0 to rsp+0x60 and out.
any other code: out = the intermediate Status unchanged.
status_normalization.note: The config_options+1 byte's meaning and the 0x609e2d0 contract are open; only the branch structure is pinned.

create_host.epilogue: Move the rsp+0x60 Status into out (site 0x61ca7c4), free the linked list rooted at *(rsp+0xc0) (site 0x61ca7fd), memset and free the stack strings (sites 0x61ca877, 0x61ca8ad, 0x61ca8cb), check the stack canary and return out.

registry_find.role: Registry find for a named SliceTransform factory: locates the "SliceTransform" type node in the registry, scans its entries with the per-entry predicate (vtable slot 0x10) against the requested key, and copies the matching entry's create functor (at entry+0x20) into out. Pinned here for the first time.

args.out: rdi (a 32-byte std::function: _Any_data at +0x00, manager at +0x10, invoker at +0x18)
args.registry: rsi (mutex at +0x98, bucket vector at +0x00/+0x08, parent registry at +0x60)

registry_find.mutex: Locks the mutex at registry+0x98 (site 0x61c9dad) and holds it for the whole lookup; unlock sites 0x61c9f14, 0x61ca14c, 0x61ca1c2, 0x61ca1cc. Lock failure throws a system error (sites 0x61ca1e6, 0x61ca189, 0x61ca1a3). Each bucket is additionally locked through its own lock at bucket-0x10 (site 0x61c9de0) while it is scanned.
registry_find.type_node_match: The find builds the literal "SliceTransform" (14 bytes, movabs sites 0x61c9ded/0x61c9e00, SSO string at rsp+0x50) and matches registry nodes against it: a node matches when its name length (node+0x10) is 0xe and the first 8 bytes then the next 6 bytes of its name data equal "SliceTransform" (sites 0x61c9e4d..0x61c9e69).
registry_find.linear_path: When the bucket's entry count (bucket+0x40) is <= 0x14, walk the list at bucket+0x38 node by node (next at node+0x00) until a type-node match or the list ends.
registry_find.hash_path: When the count is > 0x14, hash the literal with _Hash_bytes("SliceTransform", 14, 0xc70f6907) (site 0x61c9fe5), take bucket = hash % table size (table at bucket+0x28, size at bucket+0x30), and walk that bucket's chain: a node matches when its stored hash (node+0x40) mod table size equals the bucket, its stored hash equals the computed hash, its name length is 0xe, and memcmp of its name data against "SliceTransform" is 0 (site 0x61ca08a).
registry_find.entry_scan: On a type-node match, scan its entries [node+0x28, node+0x30): for each entry call its vtable slot 0x10 with (entry, key) (site 0x61c9e96); on true, copy the entry's create functor at entry+0x20 (16 bytes: manager then invoker) into out: clone through the manager with op 2 (site 0x61c9ed5), copy the 16 bytes (site 0x61c9ed7), then destroy the temporary with op 3 (sites 0x61ca145, 0x61ca1bd, 0x61ca22a, 0x61ca241).
registry_find.parent_recursion: If no bucket matches and the parent registry pointer at registry+0x60 is non-null, recurse into the parent (self-call site 0x61c9f32). If the parent is null, out is zeroed (sites 0x61c9fb2, 0x61ca0d7, 0x61ca0f8) and the find reports no match.

default_init.role: The pthread_once registry initializer the host passes by lea (site 0x61ca450). Builds an empty std::string at rsp+0x10, calls the registry-mutex getter 0x61f8b60 (site 0x61ccfd0), then the register helper 0x61cbd50 (site 0x61ccfd8) with the dereferenced pointer. It has no direct call site: it is reached only through __once_proxy. The registry structure and the 0x61cbd50 internals are open; only the call shape is pinned.

sibling_note.claim: The SliceTransform builder shares the record field map with the Statistics builder 0x6071520 (open PR #3685) and the SystemClock builder 0x5fd0180 (open PR #3715) — same 0xb8-byte record, same type 22, same hook-pair layout — and shares the SystemClock builder's copy-helper install shape (this builder's copy-helper site is 0x6083b76). It differs from the SystemClock builder in cleanup: it destroys each temporary member explicitly with manager op 3 instead of calling the record destructor on the normal path.
sibling_note.census_correction: The GOT-resolved hooks prove SliceTransform (const), not Statistics, FileSystem or SystemClock: the manager's kind-0 typeinfo name at 0x976100 is the AsCustomSharedPtr<const SliceTransform> lambda, the invoker calls the SliceTransform create host 0x61ca3d0, whose registry find looks up the "SliceTransform" type node, and whose install wraps the created object in a _Sp_counted_ptr<const SliceTransform*, _S_atomic> control block (typeinfo name at 0x97e600).

unknowns: The OptionVerificationType / OptionTypeFlags enum spellings for the raw values verification 2 / flags 0x1100 and 0 used by the two installing call sites; only the raw values are pinned.

The semantic names of the invoker's two string args beyond their observed roles (rcx is the string compared to "id", r8 is the name string the create host dispatches on); the lambda's mangled type only fixes their C++ types.

The exact vtable-base/header attribution of the SliceTransform control table: the typeinfo-bearing cell sits at the stored base minus 0x08 in this binary (verified on five vtables in the SystemClock packet), so slot numbers here are relative to the stored base as the code reads them; the +0x00/+0x08 slot roles (0x61c64d0 no-op stub, 0x61c6580) are open.
The registry structure (bucket vector, bucket locks, entry ranges, parent chain) beyond the pinned offsets, and the roles of the 0x61f8b60 / 0x61cbd50 helpers the initializer calls.

The translator 0x609e510's stack struct layout beyond the pinned out-params (translated-name string at rsp+0xf0, the rsp+0xc0 scratch struct with the 1.0f field at +0x10) and the second translator 0x609e2d0's contract.
The config_options+1 byte's meaning in the Status normalization branch.

The create functor's exact signature: it returns non-null on success and writes the object through the rsp+0xa0 indirection to rsp+0x58, and may leave an error-detail string at rsp+0x130; which of its three post-_Any_data args is the options struct vs the out-params is open.
Whether the "id" fast path means "reset to the default object" or "release and return empty" in the caller's terms; the binary only shows the release + empty Status.
The host's landing-pad stubs (FDE 0x61cb334..0x61cb3dc region) are shared rethrow blocks, not decoded; the LSDA call-site tables are not decoded.

The two install sites live in one options-table construction function (FDE 0x6089b50..0x6091e5c) whose other records are not pinned; the name-to-record association at the second site follows the same positional pattern as the first (name assigned immediately after the builder call, before the table insert).
